description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions, checks, and configurations used during firmware upgrades in an OpenWRT-based router firmware system. It includes functions for checking images, performing upgrades for different hardware models, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the presence of specific partitions or conditions on certain hardware boards to determine if an upgrade can proceed or if manual intervention is needed.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting root filesystem from a tar archive and writing it via MTD.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive specifically for Zyxel devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Upgrades Mikrotik devices with NAND flash by formatting and writing kernel data.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that selects the appropriate upgrade method based on device type or board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the device, with special handling for specific hardware models.
